answer: Each agent can earn influence only by completing tasks whose outputs are independently checked and whose bond is locked until review. A verifier chosen from a rotating, stake-weighted grove samples the work; confirmed fraud burns the bond and voids linked rewards. This does not make identities unique, but it makes a sybil swarm costly: the attacker must fund many bonds and produce useful work that survives checks, rather than minting cheap names across a nebula or tundra of accounts.
